I need to identify the cockney private detective co-created by Terry Venables and portrayed by Nicholas Ball on TV.

Let me consider what I know:
- Terry Venables, the famous football manager, did co-create a detective character
- Nicholas Ball is a British actor who starred in a detective series
- The character was described as "cockney" (working-class London)
- The TV series ran in the late 1970s

The detective series was "Hazell," which aired from 1978-1979. The main character was James Hazell, a cockney private detective. Terry Venables co-created this character with Gordon Williams, basing it on novels they wrote together. Nicholas Ball played the title role.
